newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSES STABLE ON U.S. UNIT.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSES STABLE ON U.S. UNIT.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar closed stable on the U.S. currency on Monday after the central bank intervened earlier to push it down after it had appreciated sharply on the key unit on the back of foreign exchange inflows.

"We saw the dollar moving up on the U.S. dollar but it moved down again to close where it opened after the central bank intervened later in the day because the Zim dollar was appreciating more than they expected it to," one foreign exchange dealer said.
The local unit ended at 11.2400/2500 on the U.S. dollar, unchanged from its late Friday position.
"It would seem the central bank is happy with it there at the moment," added the dealer.

On the crosses, it was quoted firmer on sterling at 18.2500/2700 from 18.4600/4800 and at 6.5800/5900 on the mark from 6.7300/7400 but held largely steady on the rand at 2.5400/5600 versus 2.5400/5500.
